Updated for the review round and re-checked against code: capability rows now name share-intake (PWA text; disabled natively), image-share-intake (Android) and clipboard-image; the Clipboard images and share target section adds the URI guard (content:// from another app's provider only; file:// and Station's own provider authorities refused before opening; admitIntakeUri, ownAuthorities from PackageInfo), per-item clipboard typing (clipboardImageItems), unsafe-name classes (Cc/Cf/Zl/Zp, refused by parseNativeSharedImagePayload), the shareDecision order (shape before extras, unpack failure is not a share, Recents ignored, taken-key replay guard keyed by task id and URIs, last 16 in preferences), that only onNewIntent triggers sharedImages, and that shares queue behind an open picker. Checked ImageIntake.kt, MediaIntakePlugin.kt, ImageIntakeTest.kt, share-image.ts, ShareIntakeController.tsx, tauri.ts/web.ts/types.ts and lib.rs. Device behavior remains NOT_VERIFIED.

The Kotlin runner now also requires the media-intake adoption, URI-guard and clipboard cases; its invocation and the agent-activity requirements are unchanged.
